blocks.title: Codebase Memory
blocks.subtitle: Tree-sitter AST across 162 languages → persistent knowledge graph. Millisecond indexing, sub-millisecond structural queries.

items.title: Extreme indexing
items.body: Average repo in milliseconds; the Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) in 3 minutes. RAM-first pipeline, LZ4, in-memory SQLite.

items.title: Persistent graph
items.body: Functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes, cross-service links — enhanced with Hybrid LSP semantic resolution for 10 languages.

items.title: 120× fewer tokens
items.body: ~3,400 tokens for 5 structural queries vs ~412,000 file-by-file (arXiv 2603.27277). One graph query replaces dozens of grep/read cycles.

items.title: 100% local
items.body: Pure C single binary, no runtime, no API key, code never leaves your machine. VirusTotal + SLSA 3 + SBOM per release.
